{"id": "65ee817b-70a6-4b81-b191-46e7036b976b", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "No, data events are never free \u2014 they always incur charges (same goes for Insights events).\n\nAs for management events: yes, the first copy is free. If you have one trail logging management events in a Region, there's no charge for that. Any additional trail logging management events in the same Region incurs charges for those extra copies. Note that you're still billed separately for the S3 storage used to hold the logs, regardless of event type.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
